open_points.subject: credential secret-file path resolution
open_points.text: “the absolute path of a secret file, or the kernel refuses to start” contradicts “Here and in rule 2 … the path as given, an absolute one walked from the root directory and a relative one from the working directory”
open_points.question: May a credential secret-file reference be relative, or must relative references be refused at startup?
options: Credential paths must be absolute; relative walking applies only to the configuration-file command-line path.
Credential paths may also be relative and are walked from the working directory.
open_points.default_guess: Keep the explicit absolute-path requirement for credential secret files and apply relative-path walking only to the configuration-file path.
